Bridge Test.stateText: Bridge Test loaded. Record one local request, then review the returned status here.

Mode Map.title: Mode Map
Mode Map.intro: Use this helper when Wes wants a Dashboard mode mapping in plain English. The blocks below are the canonical structures Dashboard should derive from the request.
Mode Map.stateText: Mode Map helper loaded. Use the patterns below to define a single mode action or a full multi-control mode panel.

controls.label: Plain-English interpretation rule
controls.text: If Wes describes one target to open, treat it as a keyed mode action. If Wes describes several buttons, helper notes, or side-panel controls for one mode, treat it as a keyed mode panel.

controls.label: Single mode action pattern
controls.text:
Key mode action
Project Room: <exact room name>
Mode: <exact mode name>
Type: open-url
Target: <full local path or exact URL>
Availability: <lan-readonly | local-only>
Label: <optional label>

controls.label: Mode panel pattern
controls.text:
Key mode panel
Project Room: <exact room name>
Mode: <exact mode name>
Controls:
- Type: open-url
  Label: <button label>
  Target: <full local path or exact URL>
  Availability: <lan-readonly | local-only>
- Type: message
  Label: <section label>
  Text: <helper text>
  Availability: <lan-readonly | local-only>

controls.label: Normalization rules
controls.text: Use the exact Project Room name and exact documented mode name from the Dashboard. Default availability to lan-readonly unless Wes clearly wants the control to stay local-only on the host machine.

controls.label: Open Dashboard README
controls.description: Open the Dashboard README, which now includes the canonical Mode Map rules.
